metadata.description: Make the Claude Pro plan last longer: exact usage HUD, a per-turn session receipt, a context breakdown, a usage limit guard, fewer tools and skill descriptions loaded per request, search subagents on Haiku, shorter shell output, quiet flags on noisy commands, capped and repeat file reads, edits in place of full-file rewrites, no reruns of a command that keeps failing, a prompt-cache countdown, a local status pane for background tasks, exact facts kept after a compaction, the right GitHub account per repository, update notices, and an Improve button for prompts. Only prompt-polish calls a model, once per press; the other mods spend no tokens themselves.

plugins.name: pro-hud
plugins.description: Desktop heads-up display: live session, week and context meters, per-turn token receipt, usage in the spinner, compact tool rows.

plugins.name: output-diet
plugins.description: Trims long shell output, Grep results and subagent reports before Claude reads them (head, tail and error lines kept); the untrimmed text is saved to a file Claude can open.

plugins.name: turn-budget
plugins.description: When one turn crosses +5 session points, writes a handoff with your latest prompt in full and continues in a fresh session by itself; /handoff any time.

plugins.name: tool-diet
plugins.description: Loads tools you have not used lately on demand through ToolSearch instead of with every request; core tools and recently used ones stay loaded.

plugins.name: skill-diet
plugins.description: Lists skills you have not used lately in this project by name only, without their descriptions; the Skill tool and /name still load any of them.

plugins.name: agent-diet
plugins.description: Runs search-only subagents (Explore by default) on Haiku instead of your main model; a model Claude asks for still wins, and /agent-diet picks the types and the model.

plugins.name: context-xray
plugins.description: /xray opens a pane with the exact breakdown of what fills the context window and which tools load on every request.

plugins.name: reread-guard
plugins.description: Skips Claude's identical re-read of a file that has not changed, with Read or a plain cat, sed -n, head, tail or Get-Content; a deliberate retry still goes through.

plugins.name: write-guard
plugins.description: Steers Claude to Edit instead of rewriting an existing file in full: the first rewrite in a conversation gets a one-line note, a later one is held back once; a deliberate retry still goes through.

plugins.name: loop-guard
plugins.description: Holds back a shell command once when the exact same command already failed twice in a row, and tells Claude to change approach; retrying it still goes through.

plugins.name: cmd-diet
plugins.description: Adds quiet flags to noisy shell commands before they run (git status, pytest, cargo, npm install, mvn, curl, wget, docker pull), so Claude reads short output from the start; errors, failures and warnings stay in full.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Status line countdown until the prompt cache expires; once it has, the exact tokens your next message re-sends uncached.

plugins.name: read-cap
plugins.description: Stops a whole-file read of a file over 1,000 lines once, with Read, cat or Get-Content, and gives Claude an outline tool so it reads only the range it needs.

plugins.name: session-receipt
plugins.description: /receipt opens a pane with the exact tokens every turn of the session spent and the costliest turns.

plugins.name: budget-guard
plugins.description: Holds a prompt back once your 5-hour or weekly usage is at or over your limit (90% by default); sending it again goes through.

plugins.name: kit-updates
plugins.description: Installs updates to your claude-pro-kit mods by itself at session start, and announces new mods (or installs them too, with /kit-update auto-new on); /kit-update installs updates and new mods now.

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another chat on this machine changed in the last 30 minutes.

plugins.name: answer-pane
plugins.description: Explain, plan and ELI5 pages drawn natively in a side pane; plan decisions as buttons, Respond fills the prompt box.

plugins.name: peek
plugins.description: Typing "status" while background shells or subagents run opens a pane with each task's exact elapsed time and last output lines instead of sending the prompt to Claude; /peek opens it too.

plugins.name: compact-keeper
plugins.description: After a compaction, adds a note of exact facts from before it (your latest prompt in full, up to 4 earlier ones, the todo list, the last failed shell command, files edited), at most 4,000 characters, with no model call.

plugins.name: gh-account
plugins.description: Runs each git push, pull, fetch, clone and gh command with the token of the logged-in GitHub account that can see the repository's owner, without switching the active account.

plugins.name: prompt-polish
plugins.description: An Improve button above the prompt (and /polish) rewrites your draft with Opus at low effort (or Haiku or Sonnet) using the prompt-master rules and puts it back in the box, never sent; each press is one model call, with its exact tokens shown.
